teaching.simple: The working version of the The Signature AI to Robot Matcher Database demo: open https://justinahiggins614-cmyk.github.io/jah-databases/db/robots/#p-gen to run the demo.
teaching.compounded: Each robot design ships a runnable demo program. The working version link points at the database's Demo Lab entry point where the demo generates, runs, simulates step by step, or opens in the interactive playground.
teaching.complex: Full working version: copy or download the demo code and run it on a PC with node demo.js. Every link is verified against the live page bytes: the anchor id is confirmed present in the page file before the record ships.

generator.cap_note: Hard stop at one quadrillion records per database, or earlier when genuinely complete (marked complete with reason).
generator.throttled: Throttled to a host-safe rate; never overloads the host or burns usage.
generator.double_check: All generator work is double-checked by the assistant and by the generator itself.
generator.dedupe: Duplicate check enforced on every write (id dedupe).
generator.output_labeling: System-generated output is marked "generated"; assistant-built output is marked "assistant-built" -- never mixed.
generator.completion_detection: Generator knows when complete: when the live manifest holds no new databases, the database is marked complete with reason and stops.

program.note: The executable demo is demo(record) in the engine file: it re-verifies the demo link -- URL well-formed, anchor in the known set, verified/link_check consistent. Node-tested at build time.

provenance.derived_from: live manifest.json + local db/<slug>/index.html anchor scan
